name: a curtain opens on a silhouette town and a figure walks home
looks: A striped stage curtain hangs around the frame, a rope pulling back to open it. Inside, flat black silhouettes of a skyline and streetlamps sit under a warm dusk gradient, a question fading in on a small wooden plaque. The skyline dissolves to a single house as a lone silhouetted figure walks up to its door.
build: The curtain is a fixed frame layered above the scene; silhouette layers pan at different slow rates for parallax; the caption plaque fades/rises in (power2.out) and holds before the next line replaces it; the skyline-to-house cut is a soft crossfade timed to the figure's arrival.
sound: A soft fabric rustle as the curtain opens, a quiet ambient bed of wind and distant sound, footsteps under the figure's walk.
prompt: Open a striped stage curtain on a flat black silhouette skyline under a warm dusk gradient, a short question fading in on a small wooden plaque, then dissolve to a single house as a lone silhouetted figure walks up to its door, establishing the whole film's hand-made, storybook register in one unbroken move.
